en.name: Energy requirement per 24 hours
en.shortDescription: Energy requirement per 24 hours — the target amount of energy a patient needs over 24 hours; in kilocalories per 24 hours (kcal/24 h).
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Energy requirement is the *target* amount of energy a patient needs over 24 hours, estimated (e.g. from a weight-based formula) or prescribed, against which the energy actually delivered is compared. It is reported in kilocalories per 24 hours (kcal/24 h). It is a goal, not a measurement of what was delivered (that is the *Energy intake per 24 hours* set).

## Included Concepts

- *604877 / 1003837001 — Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours (SNOMED)*: the estimated 24-hour energy requirement. In OMOP it belongs to the Observation domain.

## Mapping Notes

- Map a 24-hour energy target here, as an `observation` record with *604877 / 1003837001 — Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours*.
- **LOINC 9058-9 is not used**: its equivalent *3012781 / 9058-9 — Calorie need 24 hour Estimated (LOINC)* belongs to the Measurement domain in OMOP. A concept set stays within one domain, and an energy requirement is a target set for the patient rather than something measured on the patient, so the set keeps the SNOMED concept of the Observation domain. Map a source recorded with LOINC 9058-9 to 604877.
- Do **not** map energy actually delivered/consumed here — that is the *Energy intake per 24 hours* set.

fr.name: Besoin énergétique par 24 heures
fr.shortDescription: Besoin énergétique par 24 heures — quantité d’énergie cible nécessaire au patient sur 24 heures ; en kilocalories par 24 heures (kcal/24 h).
fr.longDescription:
## Définition et contexte clinique

Le besoin énergétique est la quantité *cible* d’énergie dont un patient a besoin sur 24 heures, estimée (par exemple à partir d’une formule fondée sur le poids) ou prescrite, à laquelle l’énergie réellement délivrée est comparée. Il s’exprime en kilocalories par 24 heures (kcal/24 h). C’est un objectif, pas une mesure de ce qui a été délivré (cela relève du set *Apport énergétique par 24 heures*).

## Concepts inclus

- *604877 / 1003837001 — Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours (SNOMED)* : le besoin énergétique estimé sur 24 heures. Dans OMOP, il appartient au domaine Observation.

## Notes de mapping

- Mapper ici une cible énergétique sur 24 heures, sous forme d’enregistrement `observation` avec *604877 / 1003837001 — Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours*.
- **Le LOINC 9058-9 n’est pas utilisé** : son équivalent *3012781 / 9058-9 — Calorie need 24 hour Estimated (LOINC)* appartient au domaine Measurement dans OMOP. Un concept set reste dans un seul domaine, et un besoin énergétique est une cible fixée pour le patient plutôt qu’une mesure faite sur le patient : le set garde donc le concept SNOMED du domaine Observation. Une source enregistrée avec le LOINC 9058-9 se mappe sur 604877.
- Ne **pas** mapper ici l’énergie réellement délivrée/consommée — c’est le set *Apport énergétique par 24 heures*.

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Needs revision.** Our indicator (QI03) uses only 604877 (Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours). Suggest to restrict the set to this concept: 604878 (per kg body weight), 4027088 (non-protein) and 45771253 (paediatric) denote different quantities, and the parent 4022415 (Energy requirement) is unspecific.

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI03 (Feeding).
- CQL: 1 of 5 concepts are referenced in [`IndicateQi03Feeding.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1): [604877](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1#L28) (each ID links to its code definition).

## Suggestions
- Restrict the expression to 604877 (Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours).

reviews.comments:
**Reply to the review of Gregor Lichtner**

Agreed: v1.3.0 restricts the set to **604877** *Estimated required quantity of energy in 24 hours*, and renames it *Energy requirement per 24 hours* to make its dimension explicit (kcal/24 h).

- Concepts without a 24-hour period (*Energy requirement*, *Pediatric energy requirement*) no longer fit that dimension. The per-kilogram concept is in another unit (kcal/kg/24 h), and *Non-protein energy requirement* is a subset that would need its own set.
- The LOINC equivalent **3012781** *Calorie need 24 hour Estimated* (9058-9) belongs to the Measurement domain in OMOP. A concept set stays within one domain, and an energy requirement is a target rather than something measured on the patient, so we kept the SNOMED concept (Observation), the one QI03 already uses.

Does this work for you?
